title: DevX initiative: SDK release cadence & quickstart playbook
creator: Nora Patel
description: This ticket tracks the cross-functional initiative to standardize SDK release cadence, overhaul quickstarts, and define measurable OKRs for developer experience. Scope includes a two-quarter roadmap for SDK minor/patch release cadence, a templated quickstart playbook (code + docs + CI), onboarding telemetry definitions, and a runbook for synchronized releases between SDKs and docs. The goal is to reduce 'time-to-first-successful-call' by 40% and increase quickstart-to-app conversion for first-time users.
comments: 2025-11-12 - Scoping meeting notes: agreed to prioritize TypeScript and Python SDKs first based on signup telemetry. Focus on developer journey: sign-up -> API key -> first call -> embed result. Nora: owner for OKR definition. Liam: owner for release cadence execution.

2025-12-01 - Decision: adopt a shared quickstart template repository (docs/quickstarts monorepo) to ensure consistent CI and metrics across languages. Trade-off: slightly slower initial velocity vs better consistency. Action: ENG to prepare CI templates and devx to prepare content playbook.

2026-01-09 - Engineering review: kernel scheduling updates may affect example latencies; decided to mock latency-sensitive parts in quickstarts or call hosted demo endpoint. PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devx-quickstarts/pull/78

2026-01-20 - Design feedback: quickstart flows need progressive disclosure — show minimal example first, then optional advanced configs. Figma board: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/DevX-Quickstarts-Flow

2026-02-15 - OKR draft: O1 - Reduce median time-to-first-call from 7m to 4m for new accounts (Q2 end). O2 - Increase quickstart conversion rate from quickstart page to app creation by 25%. KPIs instrumented in Console analytics (events: quickstart_view, quickstart_clone, first_successful_call, app_created).
2026-02-28 - Risk: SDK backward compatibility tests currently only run against latest runtime build. Follow-up: add pinned-model and pinned-runtime matrix for CI. ENG ticket created: ENG-4290.

2026-03-10 - Pilot results: TypeScript quickstart reduced onboarding time by 32% in internal alpha (n=45). Action: expand pilot to external beta with 3 customers: AcmeChat, NotaDocs, FinScale. Plan emails and in-console prompts for beta opt-in.
2026-03-13 - PM review: finalize release calendar (bi-weekly minor releases for SDKs, emergency hotfix process). Publish playbook draft to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1DevXPlaybook
2026-03-14 - Next: schedule cross-functional launch sync (ENG/Design/Docs/Support) for 2026-03-21. Prepare checklist for release readiness and metrics smoke tests.
acceptance_criteria: Shared quickstart repository exists with templates for TypeScript and Python and CI that verifies example builds and example-unit tests.
SDK release cadence document published and aligned with engineering SLAs (bi-weekly minor, monthly patch windows, emergency hotfix path).
OKRs and success metrics defined and wired into Console analytics; dashboards created for tracking quickstart funnel and time-to-first-call.
Pilot quickstarts show >=25% reduction in setup time in beta users or a plan with mitigations documented.
Rollout plan with gating criteria and support runbook published in the playbook Drive folder.
next_steps: Finalize quickstart template README and example matrix (2026-03-21 sync).
ENG to land CI templates and example smoke tests (ENG-4290).
Design to finalize progressive disclosure patterns for quickstarts and provide assets (DES-314 deliverable).
Schedule customer beta kickoff with three pilot customers and attach measurement plan to the beta invite.
Publish public-facing quickstart pages and link them in SDK repo READMEs after beta validation.
